name: Blind Cazul
summary: In the Cleft of Shadow, an initiate seeks Blind Cazul’s help with a succubus ritual. The sightless warlock points toward an object charged with mortal emotion.

sections.title: A Matter of Enticement
sections.body: A succubus answers to mortal longing, sorrow, and desire. To draw one across the veil, an aspiring summoner needs more than willpower; the demon is known to devour souls. Blind Cazul understands what the initiate seeks and knows where to find a fitting lure.

sections.title: Eyes in the Bluffs
sections.body: Though blind, Blind Cazul senses the lives and sorrows within Orgrimmar’s red ramparts. He sends the initiate to Zankaja, an orc woman who lives atop the bluffs near the wind rider roost. She anxiously awaits her mate Dogran’s return, and her despair can draw a demon’s attention.

faq.answer: Cazul is a sightless warlock who quietly helps the warlocks of the Cleft of Shadow. He identifies reagents and conduits for demonic summonings.

faq.q: Why does Cazul send you to Zankaja?
faq.answer: A succubus ritual needs an item shaped by powerful mortal yearning or love. Zankaja waits in distress for her missing mate, Dogran, and her bond with him offers the emotional lure the initiate seeks.

faq.q: Where can Zankaja be found in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Zankaja lives on Orgrimmar’s elevated bluffs, west of the wind rider roost. Cross the bridge from the flight tower and look in the nearby dwellings to the right.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Zankaja?
faq.answer: Zankaja is distressed because her mate Dogran has vanished. After speaking with her, you search the Barrens for word of his fate and begin the effort to retrieve a potent token of love.

faq.q: What kind of demon is this quest preparing you to summon?
faq.answer: You are preparing to summon and enslave a succubus, a demon that wields seduction and psychic torment.

faq.q: Why must warlocks exploit personal tragedies for their rituals?
faq.answer: A succubus is drawn to intense mortal feeling, especially passion, devotion, and heartbreak. Warlocks use tokens marked by grief or desire as spiritual bait in the summoning ritual.

angles.text: As a warlock, you learn that demonic conjuring depends on emotional resonance as well as fel magic. A succubus is lured by a conduit charged with mortal feeling.
As a member of the Horde, you see the dark arts of the Cleft of Shadow at work beneath the capital, touching ordinary lives on the mesas above.
